categories.name: Arithmetic & Basic Functions
categories.description: Basic math operators, let bindings, fn declarations, println. Probes the most common LLM output patterns.

categories.name: Control Flow
categories.description: if/elif/else, while, for, early return. Probes end-delimited blocks (LLM-coding-native critical feature).

categories.name: Types & Inference
categories.description: Int/Float/Bool/String/Unit literals, annotations, inference, Float promotion, String concat.

categories.name: Closures & Higher-Order Functions
categories.description: Closure literals, Fn parameter type, capture, apply_twice/compose/map patterns.

categories.name: Match & Enum & Result/Option
categories.description: match expressions, user enums, Result/Option, exhaustiveness, Form A/B, pattern binding.

categories.name: Pipeline |>
categories.description: Pipeline operator: x |> f, x |> f(y), chained pipelines, priority vs arithmetic/comparison.

categories.name: Records & Tuples
categories.description: Structural records {x: Int, y: Int}, tuples (Int, String), field access, structural equality.

categories.name: Explicit Effect System
categories.description: ! [IO, Clock] annotations, pure vs effectful functions, EFF001 avoidance.

categories.name: Modules & Imports
categories.description: from mod import {name as alias}, stdlib (io/string/math/map), no wildcard.

categories.name: Error Repair (lom fix flow)
categories.description: Given broken .lom code + lom-diag/v1 JSON, produce fixed .lom code. Tests full LLM-coding-native loop.

categories.name: Iterative Repair (single-step feedback chain)
categories.description: Multi-round repair-convergence measurement (B3, designs/0027): round 1 = standard prompt (isomorphic to pass@1), round N>1 feeds the previous candidate plus its real runtime diagnostics. Measures rounds-to-pass and C(N) convergence (C(1) == pass@1). Tasks 131-136 are verbatim copies of error_repair seeds (127, 120, 122, 128, 129, 130); 137-139 are new runtime-face tasks whose round-1 prompt deliberately omits the runtime error.
